claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu models matter as standing waves formed by particle-specific frequency harmonics within consciousness, with gravity described as consciousness-flow.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says each particle's harmonic gives it its properties.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says inhabited places form a shared frequency field shaped by the intentions of conscious beings passing through and living there.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says groups with similar perceptions reinforce their shared frequencies.
